verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs describe a structured PR summary that helps reviewers quickly understand the scope and impact of a change. Reviews can run automatically on every connected PR. However, no evidence describes a per-file change walkthrough, and nothing explicitly says the summary itself is posted automatically on every PR. Missing for 10: a documented file-by-file change walkthrough, explicit confirmation that the summary auto-posts on every PR, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, every PR gets an auto-generated summary and change walkthrough so human reviewers orient fast

citations.quote: Qodo generates a structured pull request summary to help reviewers quickly understand the scope and impact of a change.
Qodo reviews the full codebase, not just the diff, to generate a structured summary of the pull request (PR)
Once connected, Qodo automatically reviews every pull request
Trigger a Qodo code review manually or automatically, and control when reviews run on a pull request.
